      Mechanicsburg, Cumberland County · HVAC
F.M. Berkheimer has served Mechanicsburg and Central Pennsylvania with honest, reliable heating and cooling service since 1950.
Regular HVAC upkeep to improve efficiency, extend equipment life, and reduce utility bills. Scheduled visits catch small problems before they turn into repairs.
Free in-home estimates with real load calculations for homeowners installing a new furnace, AC, or full HVAC system. Recommendations are sized to the home, not upsold.
Technicians trained on current equipment diagnose the actual problem first. Straightforward recommendations come before any work begins, on any brand.
Honest guidance on whether to repair or replace an aging system. The call is based on long-term comfort and efficiency, not the easiest sale.
Free consultations on filtration, humidity control, and ventilation for today's more tightly sealed homes. AprilAire products install alongside existing systems.
Installation, maintenance, and repair for gas, electric, and tankless water heaters. One call covers the whole mechanical side of the home.
Reach the shop at 717-766-6152 during business hours, or after hours for an emergency. New installations get a free in-home estimate scheduled first.
For repairs, a NATE-certified technician inspects the system and finds the actual issue before recommending anything. No guessing, no upsell.
The technician explains what needs fixing, what it costs, and what the options are, including repair-versus-replace when the system is aging.
Installations, repairs, and maintenance visits are completed to code, with 24/7 emergency service available if something goes wrong after.

Mechanicsburg and surrounding Central Pennsylvania communities, including Camp Hill, New Cumberland, Carlisle, Enola, Etters, Boiling Springs, Dillsburg, Dover, Marysville, Wormleysburg, Harrisburg, Hershey, Shermans Dale, Middletown, Lemoyne, Lewisberry, Lower Allen, Shiremanstown, West Fairview, and York Springs, PA.
